svg.title: City encodings
svg.desc: Left: building height against CPU percent, saturating towards 45 world units with plots 4 units tall marked. Middle: building footprint side against resident memory, against what an area proportional to memory would be. Right: the order in which the first 25 districts fill square shells.
svg.text: Constants of draw_city and district_origin. A plot is 4 by 4 world units.
side if area were proportional to memory
isotop: sqrt of a saturating scale
index = q^2 + offset; shell q = floor(sqrt(index));
shell q adds 2q+1 districts; none ever moves.
